messages:
harper: FYI saw a small cluster of SSE clients getting repeated payload fragments after an autoscaler action at 02:14 UTC. looks like lease 'steal' moved session ownership mid-stream and resume logic replayed a tail segment.
noah: do you have a repro trace?
harper: short snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-06-07T02:14:05Z session=tn-312 lease=lease-23 owner=edge-11 action=steal->edge-17 reason=scale_up
2026-06-07T02:14:05Z session=tn-312 conn=sse-99 prox_close=1001 reason="lease_stolen"
2026-06-07T02:14:05Z session=tn-312 reconnect=1 resume=rt:zk9 seq=347 partial_chunk=0.23 billing_check=miss
```
harper: billing_check=miss and clients show the last ~200ms of tokens duplicated.
sam: hmm. our resume/dedupe key includes lease_owner which flips during steal. when kvcache prefix isn't replicated the new owner serves the resume without seeing the in-flight token metadata.
noah: two immediate mitigations: 1) server-side soft-steal: mark lease as draining for X ms before reassigning if stream is active, or 2) treat resume tokens with recent "lease_change" trace as dedupe candidates and consult a shared kvcache.
harper: soft-steal seems lower risk for UX but delays autoscaler. can we make it adaptive? e.g., if session bandwidth < threshold, immediate steal, else small drain window 100-300ms.
sam: agree. also console/telemetry ask: we need an explicit annotation on per-request timeline when a "lease_steal" occurred + a small metric `resume.duplicate_fragment_rate` per-tenant so SREs can triage. current dashboard only shows reconnect counts.
noah: for dedupe, kvcache table (session, seq)->last_charge TTL 30s is simplest to roll out behind a flag `billing.resume_kv_dedupe_v1`. cost should be tiny if we shard by tenant and limit to active sessions.
harper: alternative: include signed origin_hint in resume token (edge id + short epoch) so billing can compare without extra RPCs. downside: token format change and more conservative rotation.
sam: plan: telemetry first. emit `edge.lease_event.v1 {session, orig_owner, new_owner, reason, timestamp}` and a resume.attempt event. console can index these and render annotation. then enable a server-side 300ms adaptive drain for active streams behind `streaming.adaptive_soft_steal.v1` canary. then billing kvcache as fallback.\hline: (not an actual log)
harper: quick short-term hotfix: extend dedupe grace by 2s for resumes that follow a lease_steal trace. cheap and reversible.
noah: agree. also we should add a console toggle to show/hide lease events so the UI doesn't become noisy. default off for tenant overview, enabled in debug mode.
sam: rollout timeline: telemetry emit (48h) -> soft-steal canary + 5% traffic (end of week) -> billing.kv_dedupe patch (next sprint) -> token/protocol change only if we still see slips.
ops-bot: created INF-8201 to track edge telemetry, soft-steal canary, billing dedupe, and console panels. linking this thread.
harper: QA ask: please provide a sample query to find tenants with resume.attempt && edge.lease_event.reason=steal && billing_check!=detected. I'll add to INF-8201.
oah: console mock: add a tiny red dot on the timeline named "lease_steal" with tooltip: "session moved between edges -> resume may replay fragments". also a small panel under tenant ops: `resume.duplicate_fragment_rate` and last 24h histogram.
sam: owners: harper (edge telemetry + adaptive steal), noah (billing kvcache), priya (console panels).
harper: thanks all. I'll open PRs for emit + hotfix and paste links in INF-8201. :thumbsup:
